# Bay Residences Phase I

> Bay Residences is a seafront apartment development on Hayat Island at Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah, built directly behind a stretch of beach on the Arabian Gulf. Phase I delivered 324 homes, from studios to three-bedroom and duplex units, sized between roughly 50 and 340 square metres. Shared facilities include swimming pools, a gym, children's play areas, landscaped walks and parks, and ground-floor shops and restaurants. Bay Residences Phase II adds Towers 3 and 4 to the seafront apartment development on Hayat Island at Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah. The two buildings hold 324 studio to three-bedroom and duplex homes, taking the scheme to 648 apartments across both phases. Residents have direct beach access along with swimming pools, a gym, play areas, landscaped walkways and ground-level shops and restaurants, with two resort hotels a short walk away.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2025

## MENASCO Scope

Bay Residences is a seafront residential development by RAK Properties on Hayat Island in Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah, offering studio to three-bedroom and duplex apartments with Arabian Gulf views across 648 homes. Phase I, completed in 2024, formed the first stage of the development. MENASCO executed the MEP works for Phase I. Bay Residences is a seafront residential development by RAK Properties on Hayat Island in Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah, offering studio to three-bedroom and duplex apartments with Arabian Gulf views. Phase II comprises Towers 3 and 4, which were in the final stages of completion in 2026. MENASCO executed the MEP works for both towers.
